stories.headline: Nvidia Board to Probe CEO Jensen Huang's Alleged Spy Affair as Lawmakers Demand Answers
stories.summary: Nvidia's board is investigating whether CEO Jensen Huang was targeted by a foreign agent after he admitted to an affair with an alleged Chinese spy, raising succession concerns. US lawmakers from both parties are demanding details on potential national-security fallout, and the stock has fallen on the news.

stories.headline: Anthropic Readies Mega IPO Marketing Amid Filing Snafu and AI Jitters
stories.summary: Anthropic is set to begin formal marketing of its blockbuster IPO as early as Tuesday despite a last-minute filing document snafu that added drama to an already nervous market; Reuters reported the company is seeking to raise roughly $69.3 billion via the listing. CEO Dario Amodei is also planning a live-streamed event with JPMorgan CEO Jamie Dimon to discuss the offering.

stories.headline: Global Stocks Extend Tech-Led Rally as Oil Retreats
stories.summary: Global equities were on track for their best two-day gain in more than three months as a tech-fueled rally continued, even as oil prices extended declines from their lowest close since August. The move suggests investors are shrugging off recent AI-related turbulence for now.

stories.headline: Marvell's $115 Billion Lumentum Deal Faces Coin-Flip Odds as AI Trade Wobbles
stories.summary: Marvell Technology's plan to double down on AI with a $115 billion acquisition of Lumentum Holdings is getting a lukewarm early verdict from merger-arbitrage investors, reflecting broader skepticism toward AI-linked deals as the sector's rally shows cracks.

stories.headline: BLS Will Not Publish 12-Month CPI and Core CPI Figures for October
stories.summary: The Bureau of Labor Statistics said this week's closely watched October consumer price index report will omit the 12-month and core 12-month percent-change figures, a gap that complicates the inflation picture investors and the Fed rely on for policy decisions.

stories.headline: Fed's Goolsbee and Barkin Flag Inflation Risks, Signal Rates May Need to Rise Further
stories.summary: Chicago Fed President Austan Goolsbee said policymakers must address a potential inflation failure tied to AI-driven overheating and broadening price pressures, while Richmond Fed's Tom Barkin said robust demand and stubborn inflation mean rates may need to go higher, albeit at a careful pace.

stories.headline: China's Trade Surplus Tops $1 Trillion for Second Time Ever
stories.summary: China's trade surplus ballooned past $1 trillion for the year despite the biggest surge in imports since 2021, with an increasingly lopsided trade relationship with the European Union accounting for nearly a third of the overall imbalance.

stories.headline: BOJ Policy Summary Suggests Good Chance of December Rate Hike
stories.summary: The Bank of Japan's summary of opinions from its latest policy meeting showed many board members view a near-term interest-rate hike as necessary, strengthening expectations for a move in December, a week that also saw weak demand at Japan's 30-year bond auction.
